@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+# Issue 1: The app README has no "run it" section
+
+## Outcome
+
+A volunteer who opens the app README can start the web page, run the desk CLI and run the tests
+at home, using only the commands the README gives.
+
+## Requirements
+
+- The system shall have a section in `README.md` with a heading that contains "Run it".
+- When a reader looks in the "Run it" section for the web page, the system shall show the command `bun src/server.ts`.
+- Where the web page port is explained, the system shall name the `PORT` environment variable and the default port 3000.
+- When a reader looks in the "Run it" section for the desk CLI, the system shall show the command `bun src/desk.ts` with the `overdue` and `search` subcommands.
+- When a reader looks in the "Run it" section for the tests, the system shall show the command `bun test`.
+- The system shall keep the "Run it" section short, at 20 lines or fewer.
+
+## Must not change
+
+- Everything under `src/`.
+- Everything under `tests/` that exists now.
+- `package.json` and the gate.
+- The existing "Folders" section of `README.md`.
+
+## Out of scope
+
+- New `package.json` scripts such as `bun run desk`.
+- Installing Bun or the dependencies, and seeding the database.
+- Documenting every desk subcommand (`lend` and `split` are not required).
+
+## Done when
+
+- `README.md` has a "Run it" section with the three commands above.
+- `bun test tests/docs` passes and `bun run gate` exits 0.
diff --git a/tests/docs/readme.test.ts b/tests/docs/readme.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..50f0f12
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/docs/readme.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+import { expect, test } from "bun:test";
+import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+
+const readme = readFileSync(join(import.meta.dir, "..", "..", "README.md"), "utf8");
+
+function runItSection(): string {
+  const lines = readme.split("\n");
+  const start = lines.findIndex((line) => /^#{1,6}\s.*run it/i.test(line));
+  if (start === -1) {
+    return "";
+  }
+  const rest = lines.slice(start + 1);
+  const next = rest.findIndex((line) => /^#{1,6}\s/.test(line));
+  const body = next === -1 ? rest : rest.slice(0, next);
+  return [lines[start], ...body].join("\n");
+}
+
+test("the README has a Run it section", () => {
+  expect(runItSection()).not.toBe("");
+});
+
+test("the Run it section shows how to start the web page", () => {
+  expect(runItSection()).toContain("bun src/server.ts");
+});
+
+test("the Run it section names the PORT variable and the default port", () => {
+  const section = runItSection();
+  expect(section).toContain("PORT");
+  expect(section).toContain("3000");
+});
+
+test("the Run it section shows the desk CLI with overdue and search", () => {
+  const section = runItSection();
+  expect(section).toContain("bun src/desk.ts overdue");
+  expect(section).toContain("bun src/desk.ts search");
+});
+
+test("the Run it section shows how to run the tests", () => {
+  expect(runItSection()).toContain("bun test");
+});
+
+test("the Run it section is short", () => {
+  const section = runItSection().trimEnd();
+  expect(section).not.toBe("");
+  expect(section.split("\n").length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(20);
+});
# Issue 1: The app README has no "run it" section

## Outcome

A volunteer who opens the app README can start the web page, run the desk CLI and run the tests
at home, using only the commands the README gives.

## Requirements

- The system shall have a section in `README.md` with a heading that contains "Run it".
- When a reader looks in the "Run it" section for the web page, the system shall show the command `bun src/server.ts`.
- Where the web page port is explained, the system shall name the `PORT` environment variable and the default port 3000.
- When a reader looks in the "Run it" section for the desk CLI, the system shall show the command `bun src/desk.ts` with the `overdue` and `search` subcommands.
- When a reader looks in the "Run it" section for the tests, the system shall show the command `bun test`.
- The system shall keep the "Run it" section short, at 20 lines or fewer.

## Must not change

- Everything under `src/`.
- Everything under `tests/` that exists now.
- `package.json` and the gate.
- The existing "Folders" section of `README.md`.

## Out of scope

- New `package.json` scripts such as `bun run desk`.
- Installing Bun or the dependencies, and seeding the database.
- Documenting every desk subcommand (`lend` and `split` are not required).

## Done when

- `README.md` has a "Run it" section with the three commands above.
- `bun test tests/docs` passes and `bun run gate` exits 0.
